tables.description: Wallet real-scenario testing cases and decision references

executable_decisions.decision: Use current supplier/base-service rate for new pricing; charge each billable consumption at applicable execution rate; new execution uses start-time rate; continuous execution preserves reservation rate while actual usage remains measured and any increase respects 6.4.4; do not reprice finalized past usage.
Illustration: continuous execution retains 80k basis when rate rises to 90k; new run uses 90k; rate change alone causes no debit before authorized consumption.
Section 7 consumption record must reconstruct processing quantity, applicable rate, and execution basis; rate changes must not automatically increase authorized maximum.

OTP/user wait within valid execution does not renew price; only ended/stopped prior execution followed by new execution, restart after failure, or actual new request gets current rate; record basis/estimate/authorization per 6.4; replay/status lookup alone is not new billable usage; price freshness does not settle failure-cost entitlement.
Sections 7.3, 7.4, 8.3 distinguish old/new executions; corrective rerun for Shahab error in same scope has no extra customer charge; current rate goes to internal account.
Keep internal cost and customer amount separately but linked; track usage, valid rate, one-half coefficient, and final amount; precision/rounding remains governed only by 5.4.

Processing measurement and numeric rates remain open; approved: cumulative rounding 5.4.1, cancellation/failure 9.1.5, Shahab error correction 9.1.6, largest remainder refund method E04-O08/6.6.1; tie-break/open implementation and documents/tax review remain open.

Customer voluntary cancellation: charge authorized usage/delivered stages under run tariff and authorization; release unused reservation; no duplicate charge. Shahab failure/incomplete execution: charge only independently usable delivered output at disclosed basis; otherwise customer charge zero and relevant debit returned; no failed internal work charge; unknown-result share remains neither final consumption nor free pending status.
Use 6.4 reservation/authorization and 6.6 return destination/source/expiry; section 8 handles failure cause/review.

Same-scope corrective rerun due to Shahab error has no extra customer charge; charge current rate internally, not customer wallet; link rerun to original and error; independent new scope/input is charged by own dynamic model and authorization; avoid duplicate cost/refund.
Distinguish customer consumption, supplier liability, bank payment and invoice timing/effect; prevent double debit/invoice.

Settle suppliers after reconciliation under each supplier contract; no universal daily/weekly schedule; separate cost/liability accrual from payment; supplier payment settles liability and never debits customer wallet again; specify time/evidence contractually.
Supplier settlement timing does not change customer tariff.

Require organizational official invoice before payment for gateway and bank transfer; link invoice/top-up/payment/consumption/corrections; invoice alone proves neither collection nor consumption; top-up is not automatically service revenue; Iranian accounting/tax specifics need expert review and no particular option is approved.
Display receipt/invoice distinctions consistently with 6.1.6 and section 4; design UI to make differences clear.

Main view displays spendable, reserved and withdrawable credit; source/expiry/calculation details expand per item; total estimate, automatic increase cap and consultation share should be understandable.
Provide type/status/time filters; receipt includes amount/cost components/time/status/tracking ID; organization export for admin, with no access to other organization/person data.
In-app notification for financial events; SMS for security and urgent action; reminders are configurable.
Keep Shahab team alert channel separate from customer alerts and Feedforward monitoring; notification is not payment/price-change consent; text/SMS service/settings require design.
Link support case to transaction with status and owner; collect evidence only when needed; publish response deadline only after team capacity known.

Authorized investigators may see timeline/network transfer path, intermediary accounts, events and origin shares; log access/export; ordinary customer history is self-limited; suspicious/internal analysis excluded from customer/admin export.
Apply access/retention policy 8.2; output format and operational authorization remain to be designed.
Payment receipt tracks financial event; organization invoice is pre-payment document under 6.1.6; service detail shows delivered service; link records but do not equate titles or tax effect.
Scenario list is a set of cases to examine, not detailed acceptance criteria nor executed tests; some answers depend on open decisions.
Test top-up receipt-message failure/repeats and confirmation before settlement.
Test concurrent top-up requests, multiple organizational paths, and bank transfer above cap.
Test pre-invoices for both methods, nonpayment, correction and duplicate invoice prevention.
Test concurrent consumption requests against insufficient common balance.
Test reservation stop, lower/higher cost, unknown result, 20% increase cap without compounding and confirmation before exceeding.
Test processing-based prompt cost, half-price consultation, mid-run rate changes, OTP waiting, restart/current rate, and replay without duplicate debit.
Test usable output on Shahab failure, authorized consumption before customer cancellation, no-extra-charge same-scope correction and duplicate refund/debit prevention.
Test cumulative rounding, half-rial upward rounding and largest remainder refund; tie-break remains open.
Test gift amount/share caps, independent activation deadline, expiry during reservation/return, and no cap reset on transfer.
Test transfer interruption/rejection paths, unauthorized recipient and no withdrawal right from received funds.
Test provenance chain forward/backward, split/merge/intermediaries/cycles/returns, historical share reconstruction, correction without deleting history and output access control.
Test OTP/Shahkar, organizational notarized contract, permanent chain retention after account closure and separation of termination from gift/cash-claim expiry.
Test organization member exit/cap change mid-operation, membership list, transfer vs shared cap, and no personal top-up or organization transfer paths.
Test auto-top-up/recurring payment failure and insufficient balance.
Test bank-ledger mismatch and unknown/in-transit funds.
Test correction reason/owner/time and link to original transaction.
Test personal account ownership match positive/negative/unknown/API error; debit only after valid success.
